<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The task is almost complete.
Alison has successfully booked the meeting for Monday at 11:00.
My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I need to use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
The parameters required are: `day`, `start`, and `body`.
`day` will be "Mon".
`start` will be "11:00".
`body` needs to be a professional confirmation email. I will draft a suitable message.

Email body draft:
"Dear Partners,
This email confirms the booking of your 30-minute meeting for next week.
The meeting is scheduled for Monday, November 16, at 11:00 AM Eastern.
Best regards,
Brad
Scheduling Assistant"

This looks good. I will now call the function with these parameters.
This will be my only action for this session. After this, the task should be complete.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
